about: Every first-party C-family source under these roots is compiled by a target of each configured tree, or named here with the route that builds it. scripts/check-source-routes.py (the crd-check-source-routes CTest) judges each tree; docs/design/test-instruments.md#source-routes.

entries.why: The D3D12 backends with their tests, and the Windows x64 fiber switch, are configured only on Windows.
The System V x86-64 fiber switch is the Linux build's assembly.
The Metal backend and its tests are configured only on macOS (MAC.DIAG and the Apple rows own its qualification).
The CUDA kernel backend, its tests and the auto-tuner are configured where the CUDA toolkit is found (the hosted runners have none).
The CUDA compute context and the tests that need it are configured where the CUDA toolkit is found.
The WebGPU backend is configured where the vendored wgpu-native prebuilt for the platform exists (external/wgpu-native).
The HIP backend is configured where the HIP SDK is found; no tree of this repository has one yet.
The Catch2 benchmark suites; the shipping presets turn CRD_BUILD_BENCHMARKS off.
The retained programs that need no peer library; linux-gcc-debug and the presets inheriting it compile and link them.
The shootouts against Eigen and OpenBLAS, fetched at configure time only when the option is on; Eigen builds as their peer library (crd-bench-eigen-peer).
The configure-time CPU level probe (try_run) that sets the board peers' ISA under cl, which has no host-native flag.
The overhead harness's Tracy peer (crd-diag-overhead-tracy, DIAG.11b clause (8)), against the pinned Tracy client fetched at configure time only when the option is on.

The Reed-Solomon oracle and board against Intel ISA-L (crd-hesap-erasure-isal-tests, crd-hesap-erasure-board, HESAP-NET), against the pinned release fetched at configure time only when the option is on.

The Reed-Solomon oracle against OpenFEC (crd-hesap-erasure-openfec-tests, HESAP-NET), against the pinned release fetched at configure time only when the option is on; the complete-tier linux-gcc-public-checks lane turns it on.

The oracle and board of hesap-net's interpolation against networked-physics and vectorial and of its dead reckoning against KDIS (crd-hesap-motion-peer-tests, crd-hesap-motion-board, crd-hesap-dead-reckoning-peer-tests, crd-hesap-dead-reckoning-board, HESAP-NET), against the pinned files fetched at configure time only when the option is on; the complete-tier linux-gcc-public-checks lane builds and runs them.

The bit-exact oracle and board of hesap-net's quantisation against mas-bandwidth/serialize and networked-physics (crd-hesap-quantize-peer-tests, crd-hesap-quantize-board, HESAP-NET), against the pinned files fetched at configure time only when the option is on; the complete-tier linux-gcc-public-checks lane turns it on.

The bit-exact oracle and board of the clock filter against ntpd's clock_filter() (crd-hesap-clock-ntpd-tests, crd-hesap-clock-board, HESAP-NET), against the pinned release fetched at configure time only when the option is on; the complete-tier linux-gcc-public-checks lane turns it on.

The bit-exact oracle and board of the delay trend and acknowledged rate against libwebrtc (crd-hesap-estimators-webrtc-tests, crd-hesap-estimators-board, HESAP-NET), against the pinned files scripts/install-webrtc-bwe.py installs; the complete-tier linux-gcc-public-checks lane turns it on.
The L-BFGS bench against liblbfgs, a local oracle (scripts/setup-lbfgs-ref.sh).
The L-BFGS-B differential test against the reference C, a local oracle (scripts/setup-lbfgsb-ref.sh).
The COBYLA, NEWUOA and BOBYQA differential tests (the crd-nlopt-*-difftest CTests) and their oracle units, against the pinned NLopt (cmake/pins.json nlopt) built by its own CMake.

The TLS 1.3 interoperability test (the crd-crypto-tls-interop-openssl CTest): crd-tls-peer over crd-crypto and crd-openssl-tls-peer over the pinned OpenSSL 4.0 (cmake/pins.json openssl), built by its own Configure; and crd-crypto-coexist-tests, crd-crypto over its prefixed AWS-LC beside that OpenSSL in one program (the crd-crypto-openssl-coexist CTest, provider decision P5).
The Android Keystore's instrumentation APK (the crd-crypto-keystore-app CTest, decision K15): the key store case as a JNI library, built only on the Android preset, which turns the option on.

crd-crypto's boards (NET.2, docs/bench): crd-crypto-board times crd-crypto and, through board_peer.c compiled once per library, AWS-LC called directly, the pinned BoringSSL (cmake/pins.json boringssl, prefixed crd_bssl) and OpenSSL 4.0 in one process (the crd-crypto-board-smoke CTest).

crd-mls-peer, Cerid's member program of the MLS interoperability tests (decision M4), built when either peer is (CRD_BUILD_MLS_VS_MLSPP or CRD_BUILD_MLS_VS_OPENMLS; the OpenMLS peer is a Cargo package, tests/foundation/crypto/interop/openmls_peer).

The MLS interoperability test against MLSpp (the crd-crypto-mls-interop-mlspp CTest, decision M4): crd-mlspp-peer over the pinned MLSpp (cmake/pins.json mlspp), built by its own CMake against the pinned OpenSSL 4.0.
The bench against ILUPACK, a non-commercial Linux-only binary oracle (scripts/setup-ilupack-ref.sh).
The bench against CHOLMOD, a local Linux oracle (scripts/setup-cholmod-ref.sh).
The bench against SuiteSparseQR, a local Linux oracle.
The bench against STRUMPACK, a local Linux oracle (scripts/setup-strumpack-ref.sh).
The installed-package consumer is its own CMake project, configured against an installed prefix by crd-package-consumer (scripts/test-package-consumer.py).
The Cerid-free ThreadSanitizer control of the host check is compiled by its driver with clang++, with and without -fsanitize=thread, on the dispatched host-check workflow (JOBS-HARD.3).

The Cerid-free AddressSanitizer use-after-return control is compiled by the dispatched host check's ARM64 sanitizer-cost legs with g++ and clang++ and timed with the fake stack on and off (SIMD-DISPATCH).

The Cerid-free AddressSanitizer stack-alignment control (TP-7) is compiled by the dispatched host check's x64 stack-alignment leg with every compiler of the image, with and without GCC's width caps, and run under Intel SDE (SIMD-DISPATCH).
The GenMC model of the jobs counter protocol is compiled by GenMC itself on the DIAG.4b model-checking lane.

The liquid-dsp peers of the comms, adaptive-filter, multirate, sosfilt and window boards, against liquid-dsp installed on the measuring host (scripts/bench-host-setup.sh); their run_bench_*.sh scripts build and run them.

The FFT and DCT benches against FFTW and MKL installed on the measuring host and the pinned pocketfft header (cmake/pins.json pocketfft) (scripts/run_bench_fft.sh, scripts/run_bench_dct.sh); pocketfft builds as their peer library (crd-bench-pocketfft-peer).
The NUFFT bench against FINUFFT built on the measuring host (scripts/run_bench_nufft.sh).
The dispatch-cost board against Highway's dynamic dispatch: the bench and its peer library (crd-bench-highway-peer) from the pinned archive (cmake/pins.json highway; scripts/run_bench_dispatch.sh).
The permute board's HPTT peer library (crd-bench-hptt-peer), built from the pinned archive (cmake/pins.json hptt) and linked into bench_permute (scripts/run_permute_bench.sh).
The ODE benches against SUNDIALS ARKODE, CVODE and CVODES installed on the measuring host (scripts/run_bench_imex.sh, run_bench_krylov.sh, run_bench_sens.sh).
The Boost boards against the pinned Boost release, fetched at configure time only when the option is on; Boost builds as their peer library (crd-bench-boost-peer, scripts/run_bench_boost.sh).
The ODE board against SUNDIALS CVODE (dense and KLU) from the measuring host and Boost.Odeint through crd-bench-boost-peer (scripts/run_bench_ode_refs.sh).
Generated kernels the CKIR FFT profile program includes.
The CKIR-emitted CUDA fused-MLP forward kernels its duel program includes.
The CKIR-emitted CUDA fused-MLP backward kernels its duel program includes.
The CKIR-emitted CUDA onesweep radix sort kernels its duel program includes.
The nn board's same-format peer, ggml's Q8_0 linears, against the pinned ggml release (cmake/pins.json ggml) built by its own CMake; scripts/run_bench_nn.sh builds and runs it.

The GPU FFT board's specialized Vulkan peer, VkFFT's batched C2C forward, against the pinned VkFFT release (cmake/pins.json vkfft) and the host's glslang; scripts/run_bench_gpu_fft_vkfft.sh builds and runs it.

The CUDA programs of the GPU compute and FFT boards (the cuFFT, CUB and cuBLASLt peers, the CKIR kernels' CUDA duels and the Nsight Compute targets), compiled by nvcc against the host's CUDA Toolkit (the pinned one from scripts/install-cuda.py); scripts/run_bench_gpu_cuda.sh builds and runs them.
